decisions.title: Length caps do not mitigate ReDoS (catastrophic backtracking)
decisions.reason: The patched code only adds a size cap (`MAX_PATTERN_LENGTH`), flag sanitization, and (in the surrounding PR) input-size limits. None of these bound regex execution time. A short pattern like `(a+)+$` is well under the length cap and passes the allowed-flags check, while input under the size caps can still cause catastrophic backtracking. The failure scenario follows directly from the changed code because the new guard runs before regex compilation but does not prevent exponential matching. The proposed mitigations (worker timeout, RE2, static rejection of dangerous constructs) are accurate and necessary.
